title: The Zima Typology
description: Oblique preference questions. No answer maps obviously to a type; each option nudges a weighted vector across the 10 archetypes. Swap this file (bank_v2.json ...) to retune without touching the engine.
note: Public copy: questions and answer options only. Scoring weights and the archetype mapping are intentionally omitted — those live in the private bank and the API.

questions.prompt: Free afternoon, no plans. Where do you actually drift to?

options.label: The beach — sun, noise, other people
The woods — quiet, bugs, solitude
A workshop or garage with something half-built in it
A rooftop looking at the whole city at once

questions.prompt: Something in your house breaks. First honest instinct?

options.label: Take it apart and fix it myself
Redesign the whole setup so it can't break like that again
Look up why it broke and file that away
Ask around — someone I know has dealt with this

questions.prompt: Pick a texture you'd want to run your hand over.

options.label: Rough-cut wood grain
Cool smooth glass
Soft moss
Handmade paper with a deckled edge

questions.prompt: You walk into a room full of strangers. What do you clock first?

options.label: Who's connected to who — the social wiring
The lighting, the layout, how it's put together
The one interesting object nobody's noticed
The exits and how I'd change the flow of the room

questions.prompt: A perfect day ends with…

options.label: Something I made that didn't exist this morning
A long conversation that changed how I see things
A finished, beautiful thing I'm proud to show
Quiet, and a system that's finally running clean

questions.prompt: Your relationship with rules is best described as…

options.label: Rules are scaffolding — useful until they're not
I like clear rules; they let me build fast
I bend them quietly and let results speak
I'd rather write better ones for everyone

questions.prompt: Which of these could you lose an entire weekend to?

options.label: A garden, a fermentation jar, a slow living thing
A codebase or a mechanism that's *almost* elegant
A story, a zine, an edit that has to land right
A map of how a whole scene fits together

questions.prompt: Sudden windfall, no strings. What happens?

options.label: Fund three people's ideas that deserve a shot
Buy the tools I've been eyeing for years
Buy land and grow something on it
Take time to make one genuinely beautiful thing

questions.prompt: Pick a weather you feel most yourself in.

options.label: Bright, dry, high-energy heat
Grey, still, drizzle — thinking weather
The green hush right after rain
A storm rolling in — something's about to change

questions.prompt: In a group project you naturally become the person who…

options.label: Actually builds the thing
Keeps everyone talking and unblocked
Makes sure it looks and reads right
Sees three steps ahead and re-frames the goal

questions.prompt: Which small creature do you have a soft spot for?

options.label: Bees — tiny, tireless, load-bearing
Mycelium / fungi — invisible networks
Crows — clever tool-users
Fireflies — small signals in the dark

questions.prompt: What frustrates you most about the world right now?

options.label: The systems are rigged and nobody's rewriting them
Good ideas die because nobody could build them
The good work happening stays invisible
We've forgotten how to grow and repair things

questions.prompt: Your ideal desk setup leans…

options.label: Cables, boards, a soldering iron, half a robot
Two monitors, dark theme, everything scripted
Sketchbooks, swatches, good pens
Plants, notebooks, a window to somewhere green

questions.prompt: When you learn something new, you want to…

options.label: Use it to make something immediately
Understand the whole system it sits inside
Teach it / write it up so others get there faster
Imagine what it makes possible that didn't exist

questions.prompt: Pick the sound that settles you.

options.label: A room full of overlapping conversation
Rain and a mechanical keyboard
Wind through leaves
The scratch of a pen or a brush

questions.prompt: A blank wall is handed to you. You…

options.label: Paint something that stops people in the street
Turn it into a working, useful surface
Pin up a map of who's doing what nearby
Write the manifesto that should go there

questions.prompt: Which compliment would actually land for you?

options.label: "Nobody else would have thought of that."
"You actually shipped it."
"This held the whole thing together."
"This is genuinely beautiful."

questions.prompt: Preferred way to move through a new city?

options.label: Wander until I understand how it's laid out
Find the makers, markets and workshops
Meet locals, get pulled into their plans
Photograph and document the whole thing

questions.prompt: You're happiest when a plan is…

options.label: Loose — room for the unexpected
Tight and well-specified
Grown, not planned — it evolves
Ambitious enough to scare people a little

questions.prompt: Last one — which of these is closest to how you'd describe your role, even off the clock?

options.label: The one who starts things
The one who builds things
The one who connects things
The one who changes things
